snippet.title: Those Who Rule 2 - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4299520/Those_Who_Rule_2/?utm_source=yt_trailer

Those Who Rule is back in a gritty, Balkan-inspired fantasy that asks the timeless question: what makes a nation - blood, borders, or belief?

From a small militia to a force that shapes a nation, forge your squad, customize builds, and outmaneuver foes in challenging turn-based battles as you shape a gripping story of hope, betrayal, and the price of unity. 

Discord: https://discord.gg/XWzz8TnxeM
X: https://x.com/ThoseWhoRule
Subreddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/ThoseWhoRule/
